summary: Savi (getsavi.com) provides a cloud/AI video and audio analytics platform for multi-site restaurant and retail operators, including drive-thru speed-of-service analytics that connect to a site's existing cameras via a small edge device rather than requiring new camera infrastructure. (Scope note: Note: there is a separate, unrelated company called Savi Technology (supply-chain/RFID, Wilmington NC) — this entry refers only to the restaurant-focused getsavi.com platform.)

Swig, a multi-unit dirty-soda drive-thru chain, used Savi's Drive-Thru Analytics to identify where time was being lost by site, daypart, and lane position, achieving a reported 7-10% improvement in drive-thru speed without physical site changes. (Scope note: Single named customer case study published by the vendor; independent verification of the 7-10% figure was not available in this pass.)
